priorityList: --- Icy Veins Rotation (Priority List) ---
Ensure Hunter's Mark is active on the target from you or another Hunter in the group!
The golden rule is that every single non- Kill Command cast should be affected by a Tip of the Spear stack, except where noted.
Cast Kill Command to generate Tip of the Spear stacks if you run out. It will generate 21.
Cast Boomstick. It is a wide, long cone in front of you, so try to aim it if there are targets even remotely nearby.
Cast Flamefang Pitch on cooldown.
Cast Raptor Strike.
Cast Kill Command as a filler.
Cast Kill Command to generate Tip of the Spear stacks if you run out. It will generate 21. You may also cast it with 1 Tip stack if you have a Howl of the Pack Leader proc on it (it glows).
Cast Boomstick.
Cast Wildfire Bomb only to extend Fury of the Wyvern. In simple terms, you want to cast two Bombs per Wyvern spawn, and no more. See the Wyvernmaxxing section below for details.
Cast Raptor Strike. If it is upgraded to Raptor Swipe, it must be Tipped. If it is not, it does not matter to Tip it.
Cast Wildfire Bomb if you have more than 1.5 charges of it.
--- WoWhead Pack Leader Opener ---
Cast Misdirection on the tank or your pet.
Cycle between Kill Command and Raptor Strike until mobs are sufficiently stacked.
Cast Boomstick.
Cast Kill Command .
Cast Wildfire Bomb.
Cast Wildfire Bomb.
Continue by following your AoE priority.
Cast Misdirection on the tank or your pet.
Cycle between Kill Command and Raptor Strike until mobs are sufficiently stacked.
Cast Wildfire Bomb.
Cast Kill Command.
Cast Wildfire Bomb.
Cast Wildfire Bomb. Cast Boomstick instead if you have no charges available.
Continue by following your AoE priority.
--- WoWhead Pack Leader Rotation ---
Avoid using Hatchet Toss, even with Hogstrider. .
Cast Hunter's Mark if it is not yet active.
Cast Kill Command whenever any of the Howl of the Pack Leader beasts are available to summon, without wasting any Tip of the Spear stacks. .
Cast Boomstick if you have a Tip of the Spear stack to spend
Cast Wildfire Bomb if you have a Tip of the Spear stack to spend.
Cast Raptor Swipe if you have a Tip of the Spear stack to spend.
Cast Raptor Strike with or without a Tip of the Spear to spend
Cast Kill Command.
Cast Hunter's Mark if it is not yet active.
Cast Kill Command whenever you run out of Tip of the Spear stacks.
Cast Boomstick
Cast Raptor Swipe. if you have a Tip of the Spear stack to spend.
Cast Raptor Strike with or without a Tip of the Spear stack to spend.
